categories.main_business_segments: Chih Lien Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing and trading of various steel products including high carbon steel, medium carbon steel, low carbon steel, special steel, alloy steel, high tensile steel wire, PC steel wire, galvanized steel wire, steel cables, stainless steel wire, steel nails, and related products. The company also deals in ship dismantling and scrap iron trading, chemical fibers, synthetic resins, non-ferrous metal materials, aerospace materials and components, and furniture and spring bed import and processing. It additionally acts as an agent for domestic and international manufacturers for import and export services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced steel processing technologies including steel wire and steel rod secondary processing, straightening, surface and internal ultrasonic flaw detection, and fully automated acid pickling equipment. It continuously upgrades production lines to improve product quality and efficiency, focusing on automotive parts and high safety coefficient materials. The firm also plans to introduce QT equipment and new quality inspection devices to diversify products and enhance stability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chih Lien serves a broad range of industries including automotive, electronics, construction, and general industrial sectors. Its products are used in applications such as springs, nails, steel cables, automotive components, and hardware. The customer base includes both domestic and international clients, with a significant portion of sales to Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, and the Hong Kong-China region, as well as a strong domestic market presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with its headquarters and factory located in Taoyuan City. It has significant export sales to Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, and the Hong Kong-China region. The company plans to expand its overseas presence by investing in factories or sales offices in Southeast Asian countries to reduce tariff barriers and adjust its global market layout.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chih Lien operates in the midstream segment of the steel industry supply chain, focusing on secondary processing of steel wire and rods sourced mainly from upstream steel producers like China Steel Corporation and other international steel mills. It adds value through manufacturing and processing before selling to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation, cost control, and team collaboration to enhance competitiveness. Strategic priorities include upgrading production equipment, expanding product breadth and depth, especially in automotive and high-value-added steel wire products, and increasing overseas market penetration. R&D initiatives focus on introducing new equipment such as QT and quality inspection systems, although no major new R&D projects are planned for the upcoming year.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of steel products including steel wires, rods, and related processed materials. The company also earns income from trading scrap iron and other materials. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on direct product sales to industrial customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major domestic competitors include Jin Chuan, Song He, Mu Ben, and Jia Da. Chih Lien positions itself as a quality and technology leader within the Taiwanese steel wire and rod processing industry, maintaining strong cooperative and competitive relationships with peers. It leverages superior product quality and technical capabilities to sustain its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net revenue of approximately NT$1.1 billion, a 20% increase from the previous year, with a significant turnaround from a net loss to a net profit of NT$15.9 million. The company has a stable asset base of around NT$1.79 billion and equity of NT$1.12 billion. It shows a positive growth trajectory with improved profitability and operational efficiency, supported by effective inventory and cost management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chih Lien emphasizes high product quality, technological advancement, and stable supply relationships as its core value propositions. It differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing processes, including automated acid pickling and ultrasonic inspection, and by focusing on high safety and high-value steel products for automotive and industrial applications. The company also commits to environmental sustainability and energy efficiency, enhancing its competitive edge.
